title: Benign-Fine-Tuning Privacy Collapse: A Minimal Contextual-Privacy Stress Test

original_idea.body: Benign-fine-tuning privacy collapse minimal reproduction (extends arXiv:2601.15220): apply a tiny benign LoRA to a model with a contextual-privacy behavior, measure leakage before/after, sweep steps to find collapse onset.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Benign-FT eroding contextual privacy is governance-relevant but the chain to catastrophic AI risk is somewhat indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny LoRA fine-tune + leakage probe sweep; fine-tuning adds modest complexity, guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused leakage-onset curve; building the privacy probe set adds effort.

low_compute.reasoning: Tiny LoRA adaptation on a single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Collapse shown in source; minimal didactic reproduction is a partly-open artifact.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Collapse shown; minimal reproduction artifact may be open.
